name: Generate figures of whole-brain tractogram (tck)
summary: Renders PNG images of a whole-brain .tck tractogram from four views (axial, coronal, left and right sagittal) with DIPY/VTK for visual quality assurance.
description: Loads the tractogram with nibabel, renders all streamlines with the DIPY/VTK viewer in a virtual display and saves one image per fixed camera view, listed in images.json. Use it as a quick visual QA of tractography. Camera positions are fixed, so images assume a roughly standard head position.

outputs.description: The directory containing multiple images of the whole brain tractogram
